Happy Anniversary, Amma & Appa

Happy anniversary to the two most wonderful people in my life! Your relationship is a beautiful example to what true love, dedication, and healthy relationship looks like, and I feel incredibly fortunate to have grown up with your marriage as my guiding example. Through all of life's challenges, you have shown me what it means to stand by each other with unwavering support, patience, and plenty of laughter. Thank you for filling our home with so much love, warmth, and security, and for always being a support for each other and for our family. I am so proud to celebrate this milestone with you today and wish you many more beautiful years of shared adventures, happiness, and love.

With love, always.
